name: ab_3dgut_latent_drone_2k
notes: Stage 1 of the JEPA/latent plan: auxiliary 1-cos loss between frozen-ViT patch features of render and target. B_hold: constant lambda 0.1 (gate: PSNR@500 >= baseline + 0.3 dB). C_anneal: lambda annealed to 0 at step 1000 (gate: PSNR@2k >= baseline 23.25 dB, floaters down, lower early grad variance). C_dinov2 / C_layer6 are controls for backend and depth (the depth-anything backbone is the default). Matched ACE map via map_cache; baseline repeats within ~0.02 dB. Compare train/grad_norm and train/grad2d_mean in TB.
